title: How music carries over the water
summary: Music sounds better and clearer across the water; the beat seems close on quiet nights.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Playing for the audience: communicating from the bandstand

blocks.x: Well, people have told us that the music sounded prettier or louder or something over the water. Do you think it made any difference? When you'd hear it across the water, did it ever... Did it seem to carry any better?
It was sounding better from forth. It was sounding better from forth. You could hear it plainer that way over the water than you would over land? Yeah. That's right.
